title: Application of recirculation prehydrolysis technology in food waste pretreatment and its environmental impact analysis: a case study in Shanghai
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,1344-1354
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00468C, Paper

Dan Chen, Dan Wang, Luntao Wei, Yu Liu, Haozhong Yang, Feijiayi Li, Junhui Peng
Life cycle assessment shows that food waste treatment with recirculating prehydrolysis achieves a net negative carbon footprint, with the phase II system delivering the best environmental performance.
